name: create_weekly_objective
description: Create a weekly objective in Sunsama — a goal attached to one week, shown alongside that week's plan. Use this when the user asks for a Sunsama weekly goal or objective for a specific week; it is not a task, not a calendar event, not a recurring habit, and not a note, and it does not schedule any work. `weekStartDay` selects the week, so it must match the week the user meant rather than today's date.

weekStartDay.description: The start date of the week (YYYY-MM-DD format)
